definitions.gloss: gathering wild vegetables; foraging for mountain plants
definitions.explanation: The activity of going into mountains or forests to collect edible wild plants such as ferns, bamboo shoots, and wild garlic. A popular seasonal activity in rural Japan, especially in spring.

examples.english: When spring comes, I go foraging for wild vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{山菜採|さんさいと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather looks forward to wild vegetable foraging every year.

examples.japanese: {山菜採|さんさいと}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目撃情報|もくげきじょうほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した→引き返す：05872_hikikaesu⟧。
examples.english: I went out to forage for wild vegetables, but there were reports of bear sightings, so I turned back halfway.

notes:
USAGE:
{山菜採|さんさいと}り is a popular spring activity in rural Japan, especially in the Tohoku and Hokuriku regions. Common ⟦{山菜|さんさい}→山菜：12404_sansai⟧ (wild vegetables) include ⟦{蕨|わらび}→蕨：30491_warabi⟧ (bracken fern), ⟦{蕗|ふき}→蕗：30515_fuki⟧ (butterbur), たらの{芽|め} (aralia sprouts), and {行者|ぎょうじゃ}にんにく (wild garlic).

SAFETY NOTE:
{山菜採|さんさいと}り can be dangerous due to bears, steep terrain, and poisonous look-alike plants. Every year there are news reports of accidents during foraging season.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山菜採|さんさいと}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go foraging)
- {山菜採|さんさいと}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ (to set out for foraging)
- {山菜採|さんさいと}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧ (foraging season)
